0022600090.text: Both teams are opening their 2026-27 seasons, and this is the Pelicans' first game of the year at home. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 127-119 Pelicans loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision, while New Orleans has no listed absences; ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pelicans a 35% chance to win.
